missions.name: TWO OR MORE
missions.hint: Two lines at once, four times - a bigger clear counts too.

missions.name: DOUBLES ONLY
missions.hint: Three doubles in a row. Any other clear starts you over.

missions.name: NO SINGLES
missions.hint: A three-combo where singles do not count towards it.

missions.name: HALF A CYCLE
missions.hint: Two different clear sizes inside ninety seconds.

missions.name: THE I LINE
missions.hint: Six lines, every one of them cleared by an I piece.

missions.name: T FOR ONE
missions.hint: Four single lines, each one cleared by a T piece.

missions.name: CORNER PAIR
missions.hint: Three doubles, each cleared by an L or a J.

missions.name: HELD AND USED
missions.hint: Two doubles with an O piece - and it must come out of hold.

missions.name: ANYTHING BUT I
missions.hint: Two triples, and the I piece is the one that does not count.

missions.name: THREE BY S OR Z
missions.hint: Two triples cleared by an S or a Z.

missions.name: MIND THE GAP
missions.hint: Two lines at once with at least one row left between them.

missions.name: TWO ROWS APART
missions.hint: Two lines at once with exactly two rows left between them.

missions.name: SPLIT THREE
missions.hint: Three lines at once that are not all touching.

missions.name: THE T TRIPLE
missions.hint: Two T-spins of two lines or more. A triple counts.

missions.name: HELD I, BLIND
missions.hint: Four lines by a held I piece, no preview, five minutes.

missions.name: TURNED AND STUCK
missions.hint: Eight lines. Pieces arrive turned, and you cannot turn them.

missions.name: FEEL THE STACK
missions.hint: Six lines with the stack invisible. It is still there.

missions.name: THE FLOOR RISES
missions.hint: Ten lines while a row rises every twenty pieces.

missions.name: DEVIL EIGHT
missions.hint: Two tetrises, no preview, and the floor coming up every twelve.

missions.name: BLIND ORDER
missions.hint: Three singles with a T piece, and no stack to look at.

missions.name: HIGH SPEED TWO
missions.hint: Ten lines at 20G - every piece starts on the floor.

missions.name: NO TIME TO SET
missions.hint: Two tetrises at 20G with a lock delay of twelve frames.

missions.name: OOBAKA
missions.hint: Sixty pieces at 20G with no pause between them.

missions.name: EVERYTHING BACK
missions.hint: Six lines with left as right and up as down.
